subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this umbrella be split into separate TUI, sessions_send, WeChat plugin-boundary, background-event isolation, and meaningful-activity items, and which owner should sponsor each path?
rationale: The source gaps are real, but one patch cannot safely cover core TUI/Gateway behavior, external WeChat plugin ownership, and product-level activity taxonomy without crossing ownership boundaries.

options.title: Split and route subproblems
options.body: Keep this umbrella open until focused issues or PRs own each remaining behavior, with the existing sessions_send and meaningful-activity issues covering their narrower parts.

options.title: Keep as umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the human-owned tracker and block automation until maintainers reproduce the WeChat and flood/deadlock paths live.

options.title: Close after linked work lands
options.body: Close this issue only after focused linked fixes or decisions cover every reported behavior with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split and route subproblems
recommendation.body: Keep this umbrella open until focused issues or PRs own each remaining behavior, with the existing sessions_send and meaningful-activity issues covering their narrower parts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history signal across current TUI, session-list projection, sessions_send, and product-boundary evidence.
